notes.title: Restaurant Owner: Prologue v0.1.2 RELEASE
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where the time did not reset from PM to AM at the start of a new day.
[*]Fixed an issue where the trash icon on depot item prefabs did not relate to any functionality.
[*]Fixed a save/load issue with furniture boxes.
[/olist]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Updated the shop system to reset the amount selection after each sale.
[*]Ingredient freshness status is now displayed in the information panel on the UI.
[*]Added the remaining stock amount of ingredients to the shop screen, allowing players to better manage their resupply needs.
[*]Increased suggested prices for menus.
[/olist]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Added a broom model as a visual effect for cleaning.
[*]Introduced a tutorial for purchasing shelves.
[/olist]

[i]Please keep sharing your ideas, thoughts, and experiences with us. They truly make a difference. We’re excited to keep growing and improving the game together with you! 😊

Thank you for being part of our amazing community![/i]
